summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. Split of PXD015078 into supernatant (Q Exactive HF, Deamidation) and FtsH-band (Q Exactive, N-term acetyl) SDRFs is justified by differing instrument, sample prep and search modifications, and together they cover all 36 RAW files once.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent (independent-subagent-3) without producer transcript or report.md; own PRIDE API and .msf checks

spec_compliance.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --template ms-proteomics and --template plants (declared) --use_ols_cache_only exit 0, warnings only; tools structure OK.

ontology_integrity.evidence: tools check: 12/12 terms verified, 0 hallucinated, 0 mismatches. Free-text treatment/enrichment values only warn (no ontology match).

source_evidence.evidence: Deposited GUN1_biol2_Supernatant.msf: WorkflowInputFiles instrument 'Q Exactive HF Orbitrap'; Mascot 10 ppm/0.02 Da, trypsin, Carbamidomethyl(C) fixed; Oxidation(M), Deamidated(NQ), Phospho(ST,Y) variable; matches SDRF. Sample protocol states Q-Exactive HF for soluble extract. Project title verified: 'GUN1 controls the accumulation of NEP-dependent transcripts in Arabidopsis cotyledons'.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE v2 file listing (229 files, all projectAccessions=PXD015078) has 36 RAW; the 12 supernatant RAW + 24 FtsH RAW = 36 unique, no missing, no extra, no overlap.

design_consistency.evidence: 4 groups (Col-0/gun1-102 x +/- lincomycin) x 3 biological replicates = 12 rows, 1 RAW each.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value traced to PRIDE metadata/protocol or deposited .msf; no unsupported specifics. Semi-tryptic *_semi results are re-searches of same RAW, correctly add no rows.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf (ms-proteomics, plants) exit 0; tools check CLEAN rc0; score 100/100 rc0; structure OK rc0.

findings.message: 'no lincomycin' / 'lincomycin' free text; concentration not recorded.
findings.evidence: Validator warning; PRIDE gives no concentration.

findings.message: Free-text enrichment label is not an ontology term.
